units.source_text: “抱着已死之心苟活于世的我，时常由于外界的刺激而跳动起来。

en.t: “I, living on in this world with a heart already dead, would often start beating again under the stimulus of the outside world.

units.source_text: 但是，每当我决心朝某个方向冲去的时候，便有一股可怕的力量从某处钻出来，

en.t: But whenever I resolved to rush off in some direction, a dreadful force would emerge from somewhere,

units.source_text: 紧紧地攥住我的心，使我丝毫动弹不得。

en.t: grip my heart tightly, and leave me unable to move in the slightest.

units.source_text: 而且，那个奇怪的力量似乎在对我说：你是个没有资格做任何事情的人。

en.t: And that strange force seemed to say to me: You are a person unqualified to do anything.

units.source_text: 因这一句话，我顿时就泄了气。

en.t: At those words, my courage failed at once.

units.source_text: 过一段时间，我重新振作时，又被它死死地扼住了，

en.t: After a while, when I pulled myself together again, it would clamp down on me just as hard,

units.source_text: 我咬牙切齿地怒喝道：你为什么总是挡着我？

en.t: I would grind my teeth and shout angrily: Why are you always standing in my way?

units.source_text: 那奇怪的力量冷笑着说：装什么蒜，你心里明白得很！

en.t: That strange force would sneer and say: Do not pretend; you know perfectly well!

units.source_text: 我便又泄了气。

en.t: Then my courage failed again.

units.source_text: 我想让你知道，多年来，我一直过着波澜不惊、平淡无奇的单调生活，而内心却经受着这样痛苦的战争，

en.t: I want you to know that for many years I lived a calm, uneventful, monotonous life, while inside I was enduring this painful war,

units.source_text: 不等妻对我感到不满，我自己已不知苛责过自己多少次了。

en.t: and before my wife could feel dissatisfied with me, I myself had reproached myself more times than I could count.

units.source_text: 当我在这间牢房里无论如何得不到安宁，

en.t: When I could no longer find peace inside this prison cell no matter what I did,

units.source_text: 又无论如何也冲不出去的时候，

en.t: and when I also could not break out of it no matter what I did,

units.source_text: 便发觉对懦弱的我来说，最容易办到的事，就只有自杀了。

en.t: I realized that for a weak person like me, the easiest thing to accomplish was nothing but suicide.

units.source_text: 也许你会瞪大眼睛问我为什么这么说，

en.t: Perhaps you will open your eyes wide and ask why I say this,

units.source_text: 因为那股常常来揪住我的心的神秘而可怕的力量，

en.t: because that mysterious and dreadful force that often came to seize my heart,

units.source_text: 尽管封住了我的各个方面的出路，

en.t: although it blocked every way out for me,

units.source_text: 却为我敞开了一条通往死亡的路。

en.t: opened wide for me a road leading to death.

units.source_text: 我若是一直蜷缩不动，另当别论，

en.t: If I had simply stayed curled up without moving, that would have been another matter,

units.source_text: 但只要想动一动，那么除了走这条路，我是没有别的路可选择的。

en.t: but as soon as I wanted to move even a little, I had no road to choose except this one.
